page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-CPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type, and it does not feature any GPU hardware.

A key technical characteristic of this instance is the absence of advanced CPU instruction set extensions. Hardware flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are not available. Additionally, virtualization extensions such as VMX and SVM are disabled, which limits the instance's capability for nested virtualization, heavy cryptographic operations, or vector-intensive mathematical workloads.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.2xlarge offers a high memory allocation relative to its low vCPU count. This profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require a larger memory footprint but do not demand high compute power or specialized instruction sets. Workloads matching this profile include lightweight databases, caching layers, directory services, and general-purpose applications with moderate processing requirements but higher memory demands.
